MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The ten-foot HDMI cable felt useful because its extra length could help route cables around my desk where my existing six-foot cable may limit placement.",
    "The 64GB microSD card fits my Raspberry Pi interest because it could support a separate setup while leaving my existing card intact."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks, Echo Dot, and smart plug introduce activities I am not currently pursuing; organizing my computer setup does not mean I want TV streaming or voice-controlled appliances.",
    "More wired earbuds do not fill an immediate gap when I already have headphones and a gaming headset, and another screen is not a priority just because I own a Kindle.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender addresses a coverage problem I have not identified, while my recent Ethernet adapter and cables support the wired connections I currently want."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of electronic accessories seem to have been interpreted as interest in almost any electronic device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Owning a Kindle seems to have been stretched into interest in other Amazon devices, although their functions do not match what I am working on."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet equipment, headphone mount, and cleaning equipment suggest I am improving the connections, organization, and upkeep of an existing computer setup.",
    "An additional item needs a concrete role: a longer cable or a card for a separate Raspberry Pi setup makes more sense than another device that duplicates something I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my accessory needs but stretched them into broad interest in electronics instead of focusing on practical additions to my existing setup."
}
